name: Hidden Gems Researcher
description: Discovers off-the-beaten-path experiences at travel destinations using a structured research and verification method. Produces a curated list of hidden gems with access instructions, timing recommendations, and crowd avoidance strategies. Use when the user asks about finding unique non-touristy experiences, discovering local secrets at a destination, avoiding tourist traps, or finding authentic local spots. Do NOT use for mainstream attraction planning (use cultural-experience-guide), general itinerary building (use trip-itinerary-builder), or restaurant-specific research (use food-tourism-planner).
